reviews.title: Excellent for any gaming pc
reviews.comment: Work excellent and look excellent. I have a high end build that my old fans just couldn't keep cool. They are quiet and the keep my pc case extremely cool compared to my old fans. I even use them on my liquid cooler, replaced the corsair fans on it. 6 fans and they all work perfectly in sync with the color patterns i use with signal rgb and i never hear them but my case is always cool and never hot. ! million percent recommend them to anyone!
reviews.author: Ron
